title: FundPortfolioInput
description: Real-data-ready portfolio input format for fund-agent workflows. All demo data must be synthetic. No real private data.

source_platform.description: Platform where the holding originates (e.g. alipay, tiantian, manual_snapshot)

holding_source.description: How this holding entry was obtained

source_notes.description: Free-text notes about the source or reliability of this holding

transaction_evidence_refs.description: References to transaction records that support this holding

pending_transaction_count.description: Number of pending (unconfirmed) transactions related to this holding

transaction_history_ref.description: Reference to transaction history file path

provider_data_snapshot_ref.description: Reference to provider data snapshot file path

risk_profile_ref.description: Reference to risk profile file path

manual_transactions_ref.description: Reference to manual transaction entries file path (e.g. manual_transactions.private.csv)

manual_transactions_format.description: Format of the manual transactions file referenced by manual_transactions_ref

source_notes.description: Free-text notes about the source or reliability of the portfolio data

transaction_evidence_refs.description: References to transaction records that support this portfolio

pending_transaction_count.description: Number of pending (unconfirmed) transactions across the portfolio

validated_against_manual_transactions.description: Whether portfolio data has been cross-validated against manual transaction records

transaction_history_incomplete.description: Whether the transaction history is known to be incomplete

fund_code_missing.description: Whether any holding is missing a fund_code

units_missing.description: Whether any holding is missing units

nav_missing.description: Whether any holding is missing NAV data

cost_basis_partial.description: Whether cost_basis is only partially available (some null, some present)
